🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL — Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive; mixed internals with broad sector participation but concentrated mega-cap tech and financial weakness. Confirmation 1: 9/11 sector breadth positive; Confirmation 2: Technology (24 stocks) and Financials (20 stocks) are the two sector laggards, producing offsetting signals. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Utilities lead: VST (1W: +13.54% | 1M: -3.61%) RECOVERY, EXC (1W: +9.26% | 1M: +8.81%) ABOVE TREND; Real Estate strong: AMT (1W: +11.16% | 1M: +6.36%) ABOVE TREND, EQIX (1W: +10.99% | 1M: +18.73%) ABOVE TREND; Healthcare showing strength via AZN (1W: +11.42% | 1M: +10.93%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology is weak: AAPL (1W: -3.91% | 1M: +2.29%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: -4.05% | 1M: -13.10%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -2.67% | 1M: -1.11%) BELOW TREND; Financials weak: COF (1W: -7.19% | 1M: -12.76%) BELOW TREND, C (1W: -8.07% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND; Energy/Industrials are flat-to-positive but not leading.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: VST (1W: +13.54% | 1M: -3.61%) RECOVERY, EL (1W: +13.26% | 1M: -3.04%) RECOVERY, AZN (1W: +11.42% | 1M: +10.93%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +11.34% | 1M: -11.19%) RECOVERY, AMT (1W: +11.16% | 1M: +6.36%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: ACN (1W: -7.13% | 1M: -23.59%) BELOW TREND, COF (1W: -7.19% | 1M: -12.76%) BELOW TREND, WFC (1W: -7.62% | 1M: -1.27%) BELOW TREND, C (1W: -8.07% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -8.08% | 1M: -4.43%) BELOW TREND. Leadership weakness concentrated: Narrow (3/5 Financials) — financials a clear source of downside.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: VST (1W: +13.54% | 1M: -3.61%) RECOVERY, EL (1W: +13.26% | 1M: -3.04%) RECOVERY, TMUS (1W: +11.10% | 1M: +15.18%) ABOVE TREND — note TMUS shows meaningful divergence vs recent bearish headlines. Watch LLY (1W: -0.66% | 1M: +0.47%) CORRECTION where bullish Phase‑3 news (+80) has not yet produced weekly price confirmation.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is in clear pause with headline names under pressure: AAPL (1W: -3.91% | 1M: +2.29%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: -4.05% | 1M: -13.10%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -2.67% | 1M: -1.11%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -5.60% | 1M: +2.98%) CORRECTION. Sector 1W: -3.66% across 24 stocks — watch for whether positive sector breadth (9/11) can re‑engage tech leadership.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are underperforming on the week: JPM (1W: -4.65% | 1M: -0.69%) BELOW TREND, SCHW (1W: -12.89% | 1M: -9.11%) BELOW TREND, COF (1W: -7.19% | 1M: -12.76%) BELOW TREND. Sector 1W: -3.81% across 20 stocks — downside concentrated in banks and card names, keeping financials a headwind to broad risk appetite.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare is constructive: AZN (1W: +11.42% | 1M: +10.93%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +1.97% | 1M: +10.82%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +1.18% | 1M: +7.49%) ABOVE TREND while LLY (1W: -0.66% | 1M: +0.47%) CORRECTION sees strong bullish news — sector 1W: +1.18% across 17 stocks, supportive for defensive exposure.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to Utilities, Real Estate and selective Healthcare given broad sector breadth and multiple ABOVE TREND names; reduce exposure to large-cap Technology and stressed Financials until price-confirmation returns. Style: mixed / no clear leadership — be selective and monitor mega-cap divergence before redeploying into growth names.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AZN (1W: +11.42% | 1M: +10.93%) ABOVE TREND, AMT (1W: +11.16% | 1M: +6.36%) ABOVE TREND, EQIX (1W: +10.99% | 1M: +18.73%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ACN (1W: -7.13% | 1M: -23.59%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -4.05% | 1M: -13.10%) BELOW TREND, COF (1W: -7.19% | 1M: -12.76%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Utilities (1W: +7.12%) and Real Estate (1W: +6.74%) — both showing rotational strength; Healthcare (1W: +1.18%) also constructive. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -3.66%) and Financials (1W: -3.81%) — monitor for follow‑through or capitulation.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: -2.67% | 1M: -1.11%) BELOW TREND — reclaiming the recent monthly pivot would be required to shift momentum. AAPL (1W: -3.91% | 1M: +2.29%) CORRECTION — watch weekly support near prior consolidation. JPM (1W: -4.65% | 1M: -0.69%) BELOW TREND — a sustained close above short-term consolidation needed to validate bank stability.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LLY (1W: -0.66% | 1M: +0.47%) CORRECTION — Sentiment +80 on Phase‑3 win but weekly price is negative, a divergence to watch. NVDA (1W: -2.67% | 1M: -1.11%) BELOW TREND — Sentiment +60 around Meta deal yet price remains below trend, another divergence. META (1W: -5.60% | 1M: +2.98%) CORRECTION — Sentiment +55 supportive but weekly weakness signals caution before conviction.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
JNJ (1W: +1.97% | 1M: +10.82%) ABOVE TREND — Sentiment -85 (liability ruling) but price remains ABOVE TREND, a material divergence and tail risk. AMZN (1W: -3.63% | 1M: -15.55%) BELOW TREND — Sentiment -60 (Berkshire stake reduction) and price weakness confirm downside pressure. COF (1W: -7.19% | 1M: -12.76%) BELOW TREND — Sentiment -45 and price both negative, confirmed stress.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. JNJ (1W: +1.97% | 1M: +10.82%) ABOVE TREND, AZN (1W: +11.42% | 1M: +10.93%) ABOVE TREND, AMT (1W: +11.16% | 1M: +6.36%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: mega‑cap Tech and Financial stress plus several sentiment/price divergences (LLY, NVDA, JNJ) that could keep the market transitional.
